subject: Decision Making
subcategory: Famous Decisions That Changed the World
title: WHO Declares a Pandemic
description: A 60-second lesson on WHO Declares a Pandemic.

hook.text: On March 11, 2020, the WHO declared COVID-19 a pandemic. The word itself triggered trillions in economic impact.

buildup.text: The WHO hesitated for weeks. Declaring too early causes panic. Declaring too late costs lives. Timing was impossible.

discovery.text: The declaration unlocked emergency funding and travel bans worldwide. One word activated systems across every country.

twist.text: Some countries ignored the declaration entirely. The best decision is worthless if others do not act on it.

climax.text: The pandemic showed that decisions under uncertainty are always criticized. Act early and you overreact.

punchline.text: Too early or too late? Under uncertainty, every timing is wrong to someone.

quiz.question: What dilemma did the WHO face in declaring the pandemic?
options: Declaring too early causes panic, too late costs lives — timing is always criticized
